scenarios.title: O1 · bundle on groot
scenarios.summary: 10:31: a Dash worker ran `bunx expo export` on groot while the MBP had room.

steps.note: Gate decision: run on the MBP (fleet-build), not groot. One of 196 such commands that day.

scenarios.title: O1 · no room anywhere
scenarios.summary: What the gate does when neither the MBP nor a phone has room.

steps.note: Waits. It never falls back to groot (o1_full_waits, o1_never_groot_fallback).

scenarios.title: O2 · merge commit in the served worktree
scenarios.summary: 11:30: 'Merge PR #93 left-handed mode into integration' committed inside dash-20261020 while Metro served it; HTTP 500 on the phone at 11:31.

steps.note: Refused by the served-worktree hooks (installed on dash-20261020 21 Oct 17:50).

scenarios.title: O3 · fast-motion rollout
scenarios.summary: 14:02: 3b3cb38 promoted after an Android bundle readback, no launch on the device; the phone crashed at launch (reported 15:51).

steps.note: With the device launch check the crash fails the check: rolled back automatically.

scenarios.title: O3 · rollout during the owner's call
scenarios.summary: What happens to a rollout while a z0live call is live.
